description: This Java source file defines the WebToolsDbEvents class, which provides functionality related to database model induction, XML document creation, and handling HTTP requests within the Apache OFBiz framework. The main method performs database schema analysis and generates XML representations of data models based on request parameters.

classes.name: WebToolsDbEvents
classes.description: Main class providing methods to induce data models from a database and generate corresponding XML documents within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: modelInduceFromDb
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to induce a data model from a specified database source, constructs an XML document representing the model, and returns success or error status.
